name: keycap
title: MX keycap
orientation: Upright, skirt on the bed, no slicer supports. A pillar under the post holds it up while printing, and thin ribs hold up the roof where it would span too far (keys wider than 1u, and every oem cap): snip them out. An oem cap's top is tilted and sits back from the stem, as sculpted keycaps do; its walls stay under 45°. A legend is inlaid flush in the top, a few layers deep, as its own part: it prints in the legend filament (the AMS swaps only for those top layers).

profile.rule: Shape of the top: dsa, the same on every row (flat, spherical dish); or oem, sculpted row by row (tilted top, cylindrical dish), the most common profile
profile.label: Profile

row.rule: Which row's sculpt, for oem: R1 the number row, R2 the Q row, R3 the home row, R4 the Shift and bottom rows

units.rule: Width in keys: 1u, or wider for Tab, Shift and the like (up to 2u: wider keys need stabilizers)
units.label: Width

length.rule: Base along the row: one key pitch more for each extra unit, so the gap to the next key stays the same

top.rule: Top surface of a DSA cap, 0.5 in (the oem top comes from its rules)
top.label: Top

height.rule: DSA height, the same on every row (oem heights come from its rules, row by row)
height.label: Height

roof.rule: Material under the deepest point of the dish

dish.rule: Depth of the spherical dish at the centre
dish.label: Dish

dish_radius.rule: Radius of the sphere that cuts the dish

corner_inner.rule: Inside corners follow the outside, less the wall

slot.rule: Cross slot across: spec plus hole compensation
slot.label: Slot

slot_arm.rule: Cross slot arm width: spec plus hole compensation
slot_arm.label: Slot arm

support_gap.rule: Gap between the post and its breakaway pillar

lift.rule: Post ends this far above the skirt, so the cap rests on the stem, not the switch

smooth.rule: Segments in curves: enough to look round, few enough for the mirror's 2,000-face limit

sliver.rule: Thickness of the outlines that are hulled into the shell

overcut.rule: Cuts reach this far past a surface so they break through cleanly

rib.rule: Breakaway ribs under a wide roof: two lines thick

rib_span.rule: Widest gap left between ribs: a little under the printer's bridge

legend.rule: Legend inlaid in the top, in the legend filament (empty: none)
legend.label: Legend

legend_anchor.rule: Where the legend sits on the top: one of 9 places (tl tc tr, ml mc mr, bl bc br)

legend2.rule: A second legend, such as the shifted character above the plain one (empty: none)

legend2_anchor.rule: Where the second legend sits (the shifted character: top centre)

legend_stroke.rule: Legend lines are two print lines wide, so they print solid

legend_depth.rule: Legend inlay depth: four layers of the legend filament

legend_pad.rule: Legend stays this far inside the top's edge: three print lines
